parts.text: A television uses many electrical components.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) The potential difference (voltage) across a component is 72 V. The current in the component is 0.024 A. Calculate the resistance of the component. resistance = ...................................................... Ω [3]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The television uses a transformer. The input voltage (V p ) to the transformer is 120 V. The number of turns (N p ) on the input coil is 560. The number of turns (N s ) on the output coil is 70. Calculate the output voltage (V s ) of the transformer. output voltage = ...................................................... V [3]

ms.label: 8(b)
ms.text:
(output voltage Vs =) 15 (V)
Vs / 120 = 70 / 560 OR (Vs =) (70 / 560) × 120
Vs / Vp = Ns / Np in any form

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) The potential difference (voltage) across a resistor is 64 V. The current in the resistor is 2.2 mA. Calculate the power of the resistor. power = ..................................................... W [4]

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) The energy used by the television in one hour is 0.14 kWh. The cost of one kWh of energy is 36 cents. Calculate the cost of using the television for 6.0 hours. cost for 6 hours = ............................................... cents [3]

ms.label: 8(d)
ms.text:
30 (cents)
(cost = ) 0.14 × 6(.0) × 36 OR 0.84 × 36 OR 0.14 × 216 OR 5.04 × 6
(cost = ) (energy in) kW h × (number of) hours × cost (of one unit)
